notes:
T-032 (issue https://github.com/UBayouski/tracenotes/issues/29, ticket tickets/T-032-release-notes-audit-skill.md) adds two Claude Code project skills under .claude/skills/ in the Agent Skills format. release-notes-audit: a procedure (SKILL.md) plus .claude/skills/release-notes-audit/scripts/audit.ts, a factory script whose pure auditNotes() compares saved outputs of `git rev-list`, `tracenotes group`, `render --format json`, `render` (Markdown) and `check` for one range, with five checks (exactly-once, counts, json-links, markdown-links, check-agrees). pr-gate-check: a SKILL.md only, a read-only procedure for the AGENTS.md quality gate at a PR head (gh + qodo CLI).

Design facts checked in the code: groupCommits() places every commit in exactly one of ignored, Breaking changes, a type section or Unclassified (src/group.ts:111-127), so exactly-once is checked on group's output; render's JSON lists only shown entries with source.sha and commitUrl = repoUrl + /commit/ + sha (src/render.ts:85-92); Markdown has one `- ` line per entry with `[short](repo/commit/sha)` and an optional PR link (src/render.ts:142-170). The script follows the scripts convention in AGENTS.md: functions return values, only the entry block at the end touches the process. Tests build inputs with the real CLI main() and injected IO; no test runs git (rule 5). tsconfig.json and the source-hygiene walk now include .claude/skills.

Checks run: npm run check passes (typecheck + 334 tests, Windows). Dry runs of the first SKILL.md version from Git Bash: range d8199fe..3903f33 (6 commits) PASS, whole history at 3903f33 (76 commits, 57 shown, 19 merges) PASS; pr-gate-check commands on PR 28 work. Not run: Linux (CI will).

Out of scope in the working tree: journal/day-12.md has an unrelated uncommitted edit by the human (Day 12 post link); it is not part of this change. Since round 2, every SKILL.md block was dry-run again as a separate shell call (steps 2-5 of release-notes-audit on d8199fe..3903f33: PASS), and the pr-gate-check read line was tried on PR 28 and on a failed read.
decisions: Human (Nov 18): Day 13's skill is release-notes-audit (script + tests + Qodo review + fresh-session run); pr-gate-check is a smaller bonus SKILL.md without a script.
Human (Nov 18): the fresh-session run is done by the human in a new terminal, after this change is merged.
Agent: the audit reports and stops on FAIL; it never fixes code or outputs. check exiting 1 is the check's verdict on the history, not an audit failure.
Agent: the audit script lives inside the skill directory so the procedure travels with it; it imports checkRepoUrl from src/render.ts.

Human (Nov 18): the fresh-session run happens on the PR branch before the merge, so the real-range audit evidence and any SKILL refinements land in this PR (answers 2f938c17; until then the verification criterion is open on purpose).
